hooks.command: payload=$(cat); case "$payload" in *"git commit"*) branch=$(git rev-parse --abbrev-ref HEAD 2>/dev/null); case "$branch" in main|develop) printf '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"CLAUDE.md: never commit directly to %s. Cut a feature branch from develop and open a PR into develop."}}' "$branch";; esac;; esac

DIR="${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}"; if [ -x "$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; elif [ -x "$DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="$DIR/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; "$PY" "$DIR/.claude/hooks/post_edit.py"
